assets.name: 乡村面包
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE finished widescreen 16:9 artwork for a Skyrim-inspired Nordic fantasy game's loading screen. Refined simple food still life, premium naturalistic painterly rendering with exquisitely believable material textures and soft cinematic illumination. A small, carefully arranged subject group slightly left of center, fully in frame, taking about 40 percent of the frame, with substantial quiet deep warm-grey negative space on the right and along the bottom for separately overlaid loading-tip text. Understated rustic medieval setting suggested only by the surface; indistinct dark background without visible furniture or scenery. Elegant restrained palette, soft shadow transitions, no artificial black rectangular panel. No people, animals, modern packaging, labels, utensils, magical effects, text, UI, logos, watermarks, borders or letterboxing. Subject: one small round country bread loaf with a crisp golden-brown floured crust and natural scoring, one thick slice resting against it to reveal an airy tender crumb. Set on a simple worn wooden board with only a few tiny crumbs. Warm window light from the upper left reveals the irregular baked crust. Simple, welcoming, tactile, no elaborate table feast or extra decorations.
